spans.s:
√ūh1 'remove'
present: [1.] ū́hati V.+ ū́hate V.+ 
[perfect: ūhāṃ cakāra ]
aorist: [1.] uhyāt ohi -- [3.] aujihat -- [5.] auhīt 
verbal: ūḍha B.+ ūhita ūhitum E.+ oḍhum E.+ -ūhitavaí -ūhya B.+ -úhya B.+ -óham -ū́ham 
secondary: passive: uhyate B.+ ūhyate -- causative: ūhayati 
derivatives: ūha AV.+ -ūhaka C. ūhyà B.+ ūhana S.+ ūhanīya S.+ ūhitavya C. ūḍhi C. -oha RV. -oghas? RV. 
Doubtless a differentiated form of √vah, from which in some forms and meanings it is hardly to be separated.

√ūh2 'consider'
present: [1.] óhate etc. -- [2.] óhate (3p.) óhāna ohāná -- [1.] ūhati ūhate -- ohiṣe (1s.) 
perfect: ūhé etc. -- ūhāṃ cakre 
aorist: [3.] aujihat -- [5.] auhiṣṭa 
[future: ūhiṣyate ūhitā ]
verbal: ūhitum -ūhya 
secondary: desiderative: ūjihiṣa- -- causative: ūhayati etc. 
derivatives: ūha E.+ ūhya C. ūhana C. ūhanīya A. ūhitavya C. óha-? RV. óhas RV. óhasāna RV. 
Probably 'bear in mind', and so originally identical with 1ūh and vah.
